description: Get a company's stored declared cash dividends newest first. Each row gives the ex-dividend date and cash amount per share in USD. Date filters apply to the ex-dividend date. Future ex-dates can appear after a dividend is declared. Dividend records are issuer-level and available only through the company's current primary ticker; a secondary share class is never assumed to have the same dividend.

endDate.description: Optional latest ex-dividend date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 20, max: 500).

offset.description: Number of newest matching records to skip for pagination (default: 0).

startDate.description: Optional earliest ex-dividend date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

ticker.description: Current primary stock ticker (e.g., AAPL, MSFT).

name: GetDividendHistory
title: Dividend History
